Niushou_202509261000_largest_COT_error: Validation case Niushou, initialization 202509261000 BJT, largest_COT_error. Real observed and predicted AGRI use a shared C03/C02/C01 reflectance stretch; same frozen R produces both COT fields. White star: station; cyan box:3x3 GHI input. Maps sample +15,+60,+120,+180,+240min; curves use all16 leads. GHI is right-ended15-min mean; curves average3 seed predictions and are not the main mean-of-RMSE score. Future observed-image COT is offline only. Missing GHI breaks lines; valid CPP reference is shown with diamonds; COT>=100 saturates map colour only.

full_validation_attribution: Validation-only comparison and fixed-head input interventions. Left: station-pixel daytime COT RMSE relative to R(observed AGRI), not independent COT truth; support varies by lead, see cot_metrics.csv. Right:407 overlapping forecast sequences,15,275 station-init-target records,22 target dates,three stations and three seeds; bars average9 station-seed RMSEs. Top two bars use forecast-available inputs; hatched bottom bars use future observations unavailable at initialization and are only offline diagnostics. Forecast FAC minus FA:+1.687 W/m2,95% paired two-day CI [-0.340,4.089].
